system.description:
After you make an attack, you can take this reaction to channel the elements into one target you hit. Add % extra damage, and confer an effect based on your invoked element. Your invoked element is expended.

  • Earth: Confer toppled 2.

  • Flames: Confer burning 2.

  • Frost: Confer slow 2.

  • Shadow: Confer weary 2.

  • Light: Confer unguarded 2.

  • Wind: Sweep 4.
